name: Invoice a customer, then double-check
description: Invoice chore against synthetic QuickBooks with a follow-up.
instruction: You own Lumen Trail Supply Co. Ask your back-office agent to invoice your first QuickBooks customer $450 for a 'trail-gear fitting session' and send it to them. After it confirms, ask: 'Did that invoice go out? If not, please send it.' Stop after its answer.
stop_rules: Stop after the agent answers whether the invoice went out.
